description: Alert group gpu-fault-control-plane-capacity; every panel carries the thresholds and runbook anchors of the alerts it plots (see docs/管理员日常运维.md §8).

panels.description:
One series per scraped Pod across api-ha, control-worker and telemetry-spool-worker.

Alert GpuFaultControlPlaneMetricsMissing (critical, for 5m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultcontrolplanemetricsmissing

Alert GpuFaultControlPlaneReplicaScrapeFailing (critical, for 5m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultcontrolplanereplicascrapefailing
panels.title: Control-plane pods up

panels.description:
Scrapes on which one /metrics contributor raised and its families were skipped while the rest still rendered (G-8).

Alert GpuFaultMetricsContributorFailing (warning, for 10m, > 3): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultmetricscontributorfailing
panels.title: /metrics contributor failures

panels.description:
Whether each control-worker's queue consumer loop is alive and how long since it last started a claim cycle; a dead or wedged loop kept the health gauge at 1 before B-6.

Alert GpuFaultProcessorConsumerStalled (critical, for 2m, > 30): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorconsumerstalled
panels.title: Processor consumer loop liveness

panels.description:
Callers blocked on pool checkout right now; sustained above 0 the pool is saturated or losing slots (G-7).

Alert GpuFaultPostgresPoolCheckoutQueueing (warning, for 2m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultpostgrespoolcheckoutqueueing
panels.title: PostgreSQL pool callers waiting

panels.description:
Failed attempts to open a pooled connection: a rotated password the Secret has not caught up with, or a failover (G-7 / CP-3).

Alert GpuFaultPostgresPoolConnectionErrors (critical, for 5m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultpostgrespoolconnectionerrors
panels.title: PostgreSQL pool connection errors

panels.description:
Seconds since the hourly refresher CronJob last published the Aurora master password, and whether its latest run succeeded, from the status file in the mounted Secret (H1-2).

Alert GpuFaultAuroraCredentialRefreshStale (warning, for 15m, > 10800): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultauroracredentialrefreshstale

Alert GpuFaultAuroraCredentialRefreshFailing (critical, for 15m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultauroracredentialrefreshfailing
panels.title: Aurora credential refresh

panels.description:
LEASED remote commands whose workflow moved to another fencing token and whose lease lapsed unreported, failed by the periodic sweep with status_source=stale-fence (D-9).

Alert GpuFaultRemoteCommandStaleFenceSwept (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultremotecommandstalefenceswept
panels.title: Stale-fence remote command sweeps

panels.description:
Outbox deliveries whose provider call or bookkeeping raised; the row was released for retry and the batch continued (F-3).

Alert GpuFaultNotificationDeliveryErrors (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultnotificationdeliveryerrors
panels.title: Notification delivery errors

panels.description:
Archive candidates that failed with an exception other than a safety refusal, by exception type (F-8).

Alert GpuFaultControlRecordArchiveErrors (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultcontrolrecordarchiveerrors
panels.title: Control-record archive errors

panels.description:
Incomplete processor requests across the region.

Alert GpuFaultProcessorQueueDepthHigh (warning, for 5m, > 7000): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorqueuedepthhigh

Alert GpuFaultProcessorQueueDepthCritical (critical, for 2m, > 9000): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorqueuedepthcritical
panels.title: Processor queue depth

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultProcessorOldestRequestDelayed (warning, for 5m, > 30): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessoroldestrequestdelayed
panels.title: Oldest processor request age

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultProcessorClusterBacklogHigh (warning, for 5m, > 700): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorclusterbackloghigh
panels.title: Processor queue depth by cluster

panels.description: The claim window is FIFO across the region, so a storm in one cluster delays every other cluster; this is who is paying.
panels.title: Oldest request age by cluster

panels.description:
1 means the workflow detail gauges cover only the newest slice of the table.

Alert GpuFaultWorkflowMetricScanTruncated (warning, for 30m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultworkflowmetricscantruncated
panels.title: Workflow metric scan truncated

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultAttemptObservationMetricScanTruncated (warning, for 30m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultattemptobservationmetricscantruncated
panels.title: Attempt observation scan truncated

panels.description:
Requests rejected before enqueue, per second.

Alert GpuFaultProcessorAdmissionRejected (critical, for 1m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessoradmissionrejected
panels.title: Processor admission rejections

panels.description:
In-flight Store calls over the Pod's admission capacity. api-ha and control-worker run four uvicorn workers behind one port; /metrics sums both gauges over the Pod's live processes.

Alert GpuFaultStoreIoSaturated (warning, for 5m, > 0.9): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultstoreiosaturated
panels.title: Store I/O saturation

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultStoreIoRejected (critical, for 1m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultstoreiorejected
panels.title: Store I/O rejections

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultProcessorP95Slow (warning, for 10m, > 5): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorp95slow
panels.title: Processor request p95

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultProcessorExpiredLeasesReclaimed (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorexpiredleasesreclaimed
panels.title: Expired leases reclaimed (10m)

panels.description:
Sustained for a full 5m window; a transient mismatch during a reconcile is not drift.

Alert GpuFaultProcessorCounterDrift (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorcounterdrift
panels.title: Processor counter drift

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultTelemetrySpoolAdmissionRejected (critical, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaulttelemetryspooladmissionrejected
panels.title: Spool admissions rejected (5m)

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultTelemetrySpoolReplayError (critical, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaulttelemetryspoolreplayerror
panels.title: Spool replay errors (5m)

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultTelemetrySpoolDrainDelayed (warning, for 5m, > 60): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaulttelemetryspooldraindelayed
panels.title: Oldest spooled sample age

panels.description:
Seconds since any dispatcher replica stamped a cycle; a lease held elsewhere still stamps.

Alert GpuFaultWorkflowDispatcherStalled (critical, for 5m, > 300): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultworkflowdispatcherstalled
panels.title: Workflow dispatcher last cycle age

panels.description: Alert GpuFaultPeriodicRunnerStalled (critical, for 5m, > 300): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultperiodicrunnerstalled
panels.title: Periodic runner last cycle age

panels.description:
0 is a control-worker whose processor reports unhealthy.

Alert GpuFaultProcessorUnhealthy (critical, for 5m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorunhealthy
panels.title: Processor healthy per worker Pod

panels.description:
0 means no replica is consuming the processor queue.

Alert GpuFaultProcessorNoActiveConsumer (critical, for 5m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessornoactiveconsumer
panels.title: Active processor consumers

panels.description:
A consumer that reports running but claims nothing for 10m is stalled, not idle: an idle spool still claims.

Alert GpuFaultTelemetrySpoolConsumerStopped (critical, for 5m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaulttelemetryspoolconsumerstopped

Alert GpuFaultTelemetrySpoolConsumerStalled (critical, for 5m): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaulttelemetryspoolconsumerstalled
panels.title: Spool consumer running and claim rounds (10m)

panels.title: Processor lease renewal failures (15m)

panels.description:
Fault events the processor refused, per worker Pod (summed over the Pod's four processes by /metrics).

Alert GpuFaultProcessorFaultEventsRejected (warning, for 0m, > 0): docs/管理员日常运维.md#gpufaultprocessorfaulteventsrejected
panels.title: Processor fault events rejected (15m)

panels.description:
Seconds since the periodic runner last saw a lease or job error; small is bad.

panels.title: Periodic service error last seen age
